support_predeclared_important_advantage: Both adjusted interval lower bounds exceed 0.05 and declared sensitivity does not reverse; still not novelty or publication proof
exclude_important_H1: H1_info interval upper bound below 0.05, limited to this protocol
insufficient_evidence: Interval spans zero and/or 0.05, sparse groups or dependence sensitivity changes conclusion
zero_denominator: Gain undefined; no invented finite gain; report absolute paired loss, do not pass the relative-gain gate
H2_and_other_models: Secondary/exploratory; cannot replace primary H1 or choose winners from test errors
inference_scope: Conditional exploratory retrospective comparison; intervals do not correct target/protocol selection or certify untouched real-time holdout
